boundary: If the junction carried negligible traffic and fed no transit service while the unauthorised change itself breached a stated regulation, Physical / Health plus Legal / Compliance would be right.
factor: service disruption of a live public traffic system versus process-authorisation breach
note: fact_layer missed: the assessor did not state that the held approach feeds a bus interchange, so the service disruption was not counted and the authorisation bypass took the second slot. Close to a confusable pair (Legal vs Operational), but the blind audit records a missed fact.
